transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I'm here because the clinic for this logistics job I'm going for wouldn't clear me. They said my weight was too low. I don't really get it, to be honest. To me, I just look lean... you know, like someone who's ready to work and stay quick on his feet. But they told me I had to come see someone about it, so here I am.
Have you been actively trying to keep your weight down or lose weight?

Well, I don't really think of it as trying to lose weight, I just... I keep things pretty tight. Most days I stick to black coffee, maybe I'll have a boiled egg or a little bit of tuna. That's about it. And, you know, if I'm not on a shift moving freight, I just tell myself I don't really need a full meal anyway since I'm not burning the energy. So I guess my intake is pretty low, yeah.
Do you feel an intense fear or dread about the thought of gaining weight or becoming fat?

Yeah, I do. I guess dread is a good word for it. Like, if I end up eating rice, or bread... or something greasy, I just can’t stop thinking that it’s going to sit on me right away. It just gets stuck in my head. So I always make sure to check the scale, or I'll check how my belt fits the next morning, just to make sure I didn’t let myself go.
Have you noticed a decrease in your interest in sex or any changes in your sexual function lately?

No, I haven't really noticed anything like that. I mean, I guess I don't think about it all that much, just being busy with work and everything, but... no, no changes in that department. Everything seems pretty normal to me.
